input.name: Stillwater KPU-T64
input.notes:
Entry-level KPU SKU for edge AI: drones, mobile robots, fanless industrial
edge. 64 heterogeneous tiles in an 8x8 checkerboard, 70/20/10 mix between
INT8-primary, BF16-primary, and Matrix tile classes. 32x32 PE arrays per
tile (1024 PEs/tile, 65,536 PEs total). 16 MiB distributed L3 scratchpad.
TSMC N16 process, 6W default TDP with 3W/10W profiles.
